id.instruksi: Baca kejadiannya, lalu sentuh bagian tumbuhan yang bekerja.
id.t-serap: Tanah di pot disiram. Bagian mana yang menyerap airnya?
id.t-angkut: Air dari akar dibawa naik sampai ke daun. Lewat bagian mana?
id.t-makanan: Pada kebanyakan tanaman berbunga, bagian mana yang paling banyak membuat makanan dengan cahaya Matahari?
id.t-lebah: Lebah memindahkan serbuk sari saat mengunjungi bagian tumbuhan mana?
id.t-angin: Angin kencang bertiup, tetapi pohon tidak roboh. Bagian mana yang mencengkeram tanah?
id.t-seledri: Bunga krisan putih ditaruh di air berwarna merah. Besoknya kelopaknya kemerahan. Warnanya naik lewat bagian mana?
id.t-gelap: Tanaman di lemari gelap tampak pucat. Bagian lebar mana yang biasanya menangkap cahaya untuk membuat makanan?
id.t-biji: Buah dan biji tomat mulai terbentuk dari bagian tanaman mana?
id.t-siramdaun: Tanaman layu hanya disemprot daunnya, tanahnya tetap kering. Bagian mana yang perlu menyerap air dari tanah?
id.t-tegak: Bunga matahari tetap berdiri tegak menghadap cahaya. Bagian mana yang menopangnya?

en.judul: Jobs of Roots, Stems, and Leaves
en.instruksi: Read what happens, then touch the plant part that is doing the work.
en.t-serap: The soil in the pot is watered. Which part takes in the water?
en.t-angkut: Water from the roots travels up to the leaves. Through which part?
en.t-makanan: In most flowering plants, which part makes the most food using sunlight?
en.t-lebah: Which plant part does a bee visit when it transfers pollen?
en.t-angin: A strong wind blows, but the tree doesn't fall. Which part grips the soil?
en.t-seledri: A white chrysanthemum stands in red water. Next day its petals are reddish. Which part did the colour travel up?
en.t-gelap: A plant looks pale in a dark cupboard. Which broad part usually captures light to make food?
en.t-biji: Which part of the tomato plant do the fruit and seeds start forming from?
en.t-siramdaun: A wilting plant only gets its leaves sprayed and the soil stays dry. Which part needs to absorb water from the soil?
en.t-tegak: A sunflower stands tall facing the light. Which part holds it up?
